learning_outcomes.text: Be able to analyze an electrical network in transient and sinusoidal steady state.
Be able to analyze an electrical machine in steady state.

syllabus_topics: Linear and time-invariant passive two-port networks
Time domain analysis of typical circuits
Vector and symbolic representation of sinusoidal quantities
Symbolic representation of operations with isofrequential sinusoidal quantities
Network analysis using the branch current method
Network analysis using the mesh current method
Network analysis using the nodal voltage method
Power factor correction of an inductive two-port network
Electrical power in networks of linear two-port networks
Power factor correction from an energy perspective
Power in symmetric and balanced three-phase systems
Analysis of symmetric and balanced three-phase systems
Analysis of asymmetric and unbalanced three-phase systems
Power absorbed by a three-phase load as a function of applied voltage
Power absorbed and nameplate data of a three-phase load as a function of supply frequency
Power factor correction of three-phase loads

The transformer: uses and constructive characteristics, no-load operation, short-circuit operation, on-load operation, equivalent circuit, conventional tests and efficiency, three-phase transformers, parallel operation, special transformers
The synchronous machine: uses and constructive characteristics, excitation and armature reaction, islanded machine and machine in parallel with the grid
The asynchronous machine: uses and constructive characteristics, equivalent circuit and its identification through conventional tests, mechanical characteristic and efficiency, single-phase machine
DC machines: constructive notes, no-load operation and armature reaction, equivalent circuits and energy balance
degree: Corso di laurea in Ingegneria meccanica (L-9)
